install_tell: lightrag-server binds 0.0.0.0:9621, API+WebUI+Ollama-emulation all on same port. Tier-A* : an auth concept exists (X-API-Key header + JWT account login) but ships OFF by default. utils_api.py auth dependency short-circuits when neither LIGHTRAG_API_KEY nor AUTH_ACCOUNTS is set. Docs state verbatim 'By default, the LightRAG Server can be accessed without any authentication.' /health self-reports auth_mode:disabled, making posture machine-readable. Roadmap label 'Tier-A no auth concept' is INACCURATE and corrected to Tier-A*.
misconfig_patterns: Docker quickstart binds 0.0.0.0:9621 with no auth env set -> ships open
Heavily Ollama-paired (calls 11434 for LLM+embeddings); compose co-locates both, Ollama often itself unauth
Hardcoded default JWT secret 'lightrag-jwt-default-secret-key!' (CVE-2026-30762) when guest mode used
.env with LLM_BINDING_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY committed to git or exposed dir

active_probe.false_positive_check: JSON body must contain conjunction core_version + webui_title; auth_mode value (disabled|enabled) is the auth-state decoder. Anchor on json_field, not body_contains (catch-all 200 FP risk per CVAT/dcm4chee lessons).

deployment_tells: port 9621 default for API + WebUI; reverse-proxy relocates to 80/443 behind nginx
Storage backends: PostgreSQL/pgvector 5432, Neo4j 7474/7687, Milvus 19530, Qdrant 6333, Redis 6379, MongoDB 27017
WEBUI_TITLE customization is a soft attribution leak in /health webui_title
pivot_paths: GET :9621/health -> auth_mode:disabled confirms unauth in one read (names ARE the finding, no exfil)
/query against ingested corpus = data exfil via NL query
shadow-sweep 11434 (Ollama) on every confirmed host -- Insight #12
vulnerabilities: CVE-2025-6773 path traversal in upload_to_input_dir (4.8, fixed 1.3.8)
CVE-2026-30762 hardcoded JWT signing secret (fixed 1.4.13, NVD RESERVED)
category_lane_classification: RAG framework server (the pipeline above the vector DB). Graph-based RAG. Distinct from Cat-34 RAG-builders (R2R/Cognita/RAGFlow). aimap FP exists on 9621 -- HARDEN to anchor on /health json_field + wire auth_mode into auth_status.
